en.title: AI Act: is a voter exposed to the output of a campaign tool whose recommended messages staff send on?
en.summary: Annex III, point 8(b), excludes AI systems to the output of which natural persons are not directly exposed. A campaign tool ranks voters and recommends which message each voter should receive; campaign staff then send those messages. The text does not say whether this counts as direct exposure to the output of the system, read with recital 62.
en.impact: Whether the campaign tool falls under point 8(b) depends on whether the voter counts as directly exposed to its output: the internal ranking or the message the voter receives.
en.correction: The guidelines could say whether mediated exposure of this kind is direct exposure.

quotes.source: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act), Official Journal, 12 July 2024, English version
